name: black-friday-ad-spend-on-low-stock-products
description: Use for "are we advertising products about to sell out in our store", "which product ads should we pause for low stock", "move ad budget off low-stock products", "we're paying for clicks on sold-out sizes", or a Cyber Monday stock check against the ads.
